topic.title: If one $200 billion fortune were split among everyone on Earth

title: Split one giant fortune with everyone. Here's your share 🌍
description:
Would sharing one giant fortune with the whole planet make everyone rich? Watch an assumed fortune get sliced, then see how long one salary takes to earn it.
An animated story with illustrative, assumed round numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Split it or leave it? Comment

lines.text: You think splitting one fortune makes everyone rich? It doesn't.
Say a billionaire has $200.00B, shared by everyone alive.
That's the whole planet, each one waiting for a slice. How much?
Each person gets just $25. That's one dinner, once.
But for one worker, that same pile is huge.
At $50,000 a year, earning it all takes 4M years.
Huge for one, a dinner for all. Still want it split?
